content.text:
### Guide-required runtime prerequisites (all absent?)
/opt/deegree         MISSING
/opt/xplanbox        MISSING
/root/.deegree       MISSING
/root/xplanbox       MISSING

### env vars set?
DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT       UNSET
XPLANBOX_CONFIG              UNSET
XPLAN_S3_ACCESS_KEY          UNSET
XPLAN_DB_HOSTNAME            UNSET
XPLAN_RABBIT_HOST            UNSET

### Tomcat / deployed webapps

### Running/listening

### external infra reachability
5432 closed
5672 closed
9000 closed
8080 closed

observation.command:
echo "### Guide-required runtime prerequisites (all absent?)"; for d in /opt/deegree /opt/xplanbox /root/.deegree /root/xplanbox; do printf "%-20s " "$d"; [ -e "$d" ] && echo EXISTS || echo MISSING; done
echo; echo "### env vars set?"; for v in DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT XPLANBOX_CONFIG XPLAN_S3_ACCESS_KEY XPLAN_DB_HOSTNAME XPLAN_RABBIT_HOST; do printf "%-28s " "$v"; printenv "$v" >/dev/null && echo SET || echo UNSET; done
echo; echo "### Tomcat / deployed webapps"; find / -name catalina.sh 2>/dev/null | head; find / -path "*/webapps/*.war" 2>/dev/null | head
echo; echo "### Running/listening"; ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | head
echo; echo "### external infra reachability"; for p in 5432 5672 9000 8080; do timeout 2 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$p" 2>/dev/null && echo "$p OPEN" || echo "$p closed"; done
